childhoodeyebrainimages.visual_development_intro_paragraph_1: Ntango bana bazali kobotama, bomoni na bango ezalaka malembe. Na moboko bazalaka lokola 'bakufi miso'. Kasi bomoni na bango ekokola malembe malembe na kati ya mbula 5 tii 8 oyo ezali koya, mpe kobongwana monene mingi esalemaka na sanza 18 ya liboso ya bomoi. Oyo ezali eleko ya ntina mingi.
childhoodeyebrainimages.visual_development_intro_paragraph_2: Na eleko oyo, système ya komona ya miso mpe ya bongo esengeli kozala malamu mpe kozwa stimulation. Oyo ezali eleko ya malamu mingi mpo na koyeba bokono mpe kotinda mpo na traitement.

childhoodeyebrainimages.visual_development_identify_disease_body: Bokono nyonso ya liso to ya bongo ekobebisa bokoli mpe ekokangela bomoni ya ntango molai. Yango wana ezali na ntina koyeba noki ndenge ekoki kozala bantina ya bokono oyo ekoki kosalisa na traitement mpe oyo ezali kobebisa bokoli ya bomoni ya malamu mpe bokoli ya nzoto mobimba.

i18nLiteral.A white pupil present from birth, with p: Mwana ya mpɛmbɛ oyo azali wana banda kobotama, oyo amonaka malamu te, ekokani na cataracte congénitale.
i18nLiteral.Gradual, painless worsening vision over: Kobeba ya komona mokemoke, kozanga mpasi na boumeli ya basanza epai ya mokóló oyo akómi mokóló, ekɔtaka na cataracte.
i18nLiteral.A white pupil in a young child with redu: Mwana-kelasi ya mpɛmbɛ na mwana moke oyo azali komonana mingi te azali komitungisa mpo na rétinoblastome.
i18nLiteral.Acute onset, pink eye, yellow discharge: Début aiguë, liso rose, décharge jaune mpe ba symptômes oyo ezali kobeba ekokani na conjonctivite makasi.
i18nLiteral.Long-term irritation with painful gritty: Irritation ya ntango molai na sensation gritty ya mpasi, liso rouge mpe vision floue ekokani na trichiasis na cicatrices.
i18nLiteral.Corneal trauma followed by increasing pa: Traumatisme ya cornée oyo elandi na bomati ya mpasi, rougeur mpe perte ya vision epesi likanisi ya ulcère ya cornée.
i18nLiteral.Unilateral gritty watery eye with a rece: Liso ya mayi ya gritty unilatéral na lésion ya lèvre oyo euti kosalema kala mingi te ekokani na kératite herpès simplex.
i18nLiteral.Photophobia with watery eye and blurred: Photophobie na liso ya mayi mpe vision flou epesi likanisi ya uveïte antérieure.
i18nLiteral.Slowly progressive irritation and blur i: Kosilika mokemoke mpe kokangama na mobange, mbala mingi liso moko, ekokani na pterygium.
i18nLiteral.Foreign body exposure (working under a c: Kozala na nzoto ya bapaya (kosala na nse ya motuka) na bilembo ya gritty, oyo ezali kobeba elakisi nzoto ya bapaya oyo ekangami na bokono ya ebandeli.
i18nLiteral.Blunt trauma with red eye and very poor: Traumatisme blunt na liso rouge mpe vision très mal epesi likanisi ya hyphéma.
i18nLiteral.Stick injury with pain, red eye and wors: Kozoka na nzete na mpasi, miso motane mpe kobeba ya komona ekoki kolakisa laceration ya cornée oyo ekɔtaka na kati.
i18nLiteral.Stick injury with very poor vision and r: Kozoka ya nzete na bomoni ya mabe mpenza mpe miso motane ekoki kolakisa kozoka oyo ekɔtaka na kati oyo epesaka cataracte traumatique.

i18nLiteral.Fast vision loss over hours to days with: Kobungisa komona nokinoki na boumeli ya bangonga kino mikolo na liso ya motane ya mpasi mpe ba halos nzinganzinga ya miinda oyo ezali na likama mingi na fond ya Asie, mbula ya mibange mpe cataracte ekokani na ACAG.
i18nLiteral.My vision is not as good as it used to b: Vision na ngai ezali malamu te ndenge ezalaki liboso. Ezali kobongwana mokemoke mpenza.
i18nLiteral.It started a long time ago, maybe months: Ebandaki kala mingi te, mbala mosusu basanza kino bambula.
i18nLiteral.It came on slowly. There was no injury o: Ekɔtaki malɛmbɛmalɛmbɛ. Ezalaki na moto moko te oyo azokaki to likambo ya mbalakaka.

i18nLiteral.No redness and no discharge. The eye loo: Rougeur te mpe décharge te. Liso ezali komonana mpɛmbɛ.

i18nLiteral.My vision suddenly became blurry and my: Vision na ngai ekómaki na mbalakaka flou mpe liso na ngai ezali kosala ngai mpasi mingi.
i18nLiteral.It started suddenly, within the last few: Ebandaki na mbalakaka, na boumeli ya mwa bangonga oyo euti koleka.
i18nLiteral.Yes, the eye is red. There is no dischar: Ɛɛ, liso ezali motane. Décharge ezali te.

i18nLiteral.I see halos around lights. I have had a: Namonaka ba halos zingazinga ya miinda. Nakutanaki na likambo ya ndenge wana liboso ete likambo yango esila. Nazali na miso molai mpe nazali na mposa ya ba lunettes mpo na komona penepene. Bayebisaki ngai ete nazali na ba cataractes.

i18nLiteral.Clinical signs are consistent with this: Bilembo ya clinique ezali na boyokani na étiquette ya cas oyo.
i18nLiteral.Good vision and long outdoor work make t: Komona malamu mpe kosala mosala molai na libándá esalaka ete báyeba maladi yango.

i18nLiteral.No red eye or discharge suggests catarac: Liso moko te ya motane to mai oyo ebimaka emonisaka ete moto azali na cataracte, kasi te ete moto azali na maladi ya miso.
i18nLiteral.One painful light-sensitive eye with wat: Liso moko ya mpasi oyo eyokaka pole mpe ezali motane lokola mai epesi likanisi ya kératite.
i18nLiteral.Painful red eye with fast decline suppor: Liso motane ya mpasi na bokiti ya mbangu esungaka cataracte traumatique.
i18nLiteral.Photophobia, pain, and blurred vision in: Photophobie, mpasi, mpe komona malamu te na liso moko epesi likanisi ya uveïte.
i18nLiteral.Poor visual attention supports this diag: Kozanga likebi na miso esungaka diagnostic oyo mpe esengeli kotindama nokinoki.
i18nLiteral.Recent painful lip sores support herpes: Bampota ya mbɛbu oyo euti kosala mpasi esungaka kératite ya herpès simplex.
i18nLiteral.Repeated similar episodes support anteri: Ba épisodes ya ndenge moko oyo ezongaka mbala na mbala esungaka uveïte antérieure.
i18nLiteral.Severe pain and red eye after a scratch: Pasi makasi mpe liso motane nsima ya kokatakata uta na zamba epesi likanisi ya ulcère ya cornée.
i18nLiteral.Severe vision loss after stick trauma su: Kobungisa komona makasi nsima ya mpasi ya nzete epesi likanisi ya kozoka ya miso oyo ekɔtaka na kati.
i18nLiteral.Stick injury with worsening pain and blu: Kozoka ya nzete na mpasi oyo ezali se kobeba mpe flou epesi likanisi ya traumatisme ya globe ouvert.

Ezali conseil académique, juridique to professionnel officiel te mpe ekoki te ko garantir ba passes ya examen, ba notes to résultat moko boye. Maponami ya boyekoli mpe mikano etikali mokumba ya mosaleli.
i18nExtra.onboarding_privacy_how_we_use_data:
Ba données oyo esalisaka pona ko adapter appli na ba objectifs ya mutu na mutu, ko comprendre ndenge app esalelamaka pe ko améliorer ba fonctionnalités na tango. Ekoki mpe kosalelama mpo na kozwa boyokani mpo na mbongwana ya ntina na appli to na compte.
Badonnées personnelles etekamaka ata moke te.
i18nExtra.onboarding_privacy_identity_check: Ekoki kozala ete esengeli kondimisa bomoto liboso ya kosilisa bosengi. Soki esengeli kobomba sango moko mpo na bantina ya mibeko to ya bokengi, yango ekolimbolama.
i18nExtra.onboarding_privacy_minimum_data: Kaka ba informations oyo esengeli pona ko diriger pe ko améliorer service nde ezuami.
i18nExtra.onboarding_privacy_service_limits: Mokano ezali ya kobatela appli yango na litomba mpe ya kotyela motema, kasi service moko te ezali ya kokoka. Bozali ntango nyonso to bonsomi mobimba na mabunga ekoki kolaka te, mpe mbala mosusu appli yango ekokani te na likambo nyonso.
i18nExtra.onboarding_privacy_storage: Ba informations ebombamaka na serveur géré mpe na base de données oyo epesami na Railway. Chemin de fer epesaka ba hébergements mpe ba infrastructures; tozali kotambwisa ndenge oyo ba données esalelamaka na kati ya appli mpe tobombaka yango kaka mpo na ntango molai oyo esengeli.
i18nExtra.onboarding_privacy_third_party: Tozali kotya motema na misala ya bato mosusu oyo totyelaka motema, na ndakisa ba fournisseurs ya hébergement, mpo na kotambwisa appli. Ba services oyo esalaka kaka ba données ndenge esengeli pona kopesa ba infrastructures pe ezali na ndingisa te ya kosalela yango pona ba but na bango moko.
i18nExtra.onboarding_privacy_uk_law_limits: Na ndenge mibeko ya Royaume-Uni epesi nzela, tozali na mokumba te ya kobungisa lokola ba marques oyo ezangaki, mosolo oyo ebungaki to mabaku oyo euti na kosalela, to kozanga makoki ya kosalela, appli. Eloko moko te awa elongoli makoki nyonso oyo mibeko ya Royaume-Uni epesi.
